question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Adequacy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Dearth**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Adequacy"** means the state of being sufficient or satisfactory in quantity or quality. (पर्याप्तता)
 
 
• **Example: **The adequacy of the resources was assessed before starting the project.
 
 
 
• **"Dearth" **refers to a scarcity or lack of something. (कमी)
 
 
• **Example: **There was a dearth of evidence to support the claim.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Adequacy' **is **'Dearth'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Dearth**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Opulence **(धन-वैभव): Great wealth or luxuriousness.
 
 
• **Example:** The opulence of the palace was breathtaking.
 
 
 
• **Rational **(तार्किक): Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.
 
 
• **Example: **His decision was rational and well thought out.
 
 
 
• **Surplus** (अधिशेष): An amount of something left over when requirements have been met.
 
 
• **Example:** The surplus food was donated to the local shelter.
 
 

32:Te4d,

The correct answer is: Option 3<
